body.x: ChoisTechnology(representative Soon-pil Choi, www.choistec.com) will show X-pointer 'XPM145' at CES 2012, held in Las Vegas, US, from Jan 10-13.

'XPM145' has been developed through 'ChoisTechnology's technique skill that has been advanced over 10 years. It's equipped with Laser and it has special Brightness more than two times than normal red laser, also clear pointing is available at long distances.

In addition, it can be utilized as presentation pointer and all powerful remote control by designating hot keys of bookmarks with 'Magic key' function, and it solved a problem generated on Preizi, Macintosh, Keynote and others.
Above these, there is an battery usage check function, and Black Pearl provides premium and luxury design. Also it's pleasing to the touch.

ChoisTechnology is leading the presentation pointer field with 'X-pointer' Korea brand, now they are selling products to Large stationary Shops, Major retail outlets and Domestic large Shops like Young-poong Bookstore, Kyobo Bookstore, Bandi&Luni's and others.

Also, they are exporting presentation products to over 10 countries including America, Europe, Japan since 2004. Recently, application and next generation user interface are studied for smart devices.
